hypothesis: Root cause: the SCRAM password of the Postgres replication user debezium was rotated, so Debezium cannot log in to the source database and pg-payments-connector task 0 failed.

verdict.reason: The hypothesis blames a rotated Postgres replication password, meaning a failed login to the source database. The real cause is the rotated Kafka SCRAM credential, which the broker rejects with SaslAuthenticationException. The first failing layer (connector task in kafka-connect) is right, but the root cause is placed in postgres.
